I ran out of tool-call steps before finishing. Here is what the tools returned so far; ask a narrower question or raise --max-steps. Repeated calls: assess_site x3, regionalize_signatures x3.

## What this answer does not establish

- The answer does not say which station or record the numbers come from.

## Data

- **regionalised signatures at 40.2, -8.0** · licence per-source (streamflow), CC-BY-4.0 (BasinATLAS) · donor gauges (per-source licences); BasinATLAS (CC BY 4.0)

## Methods and citations

1. **Regionalisation of flow signatures from similar gauged basins.** Donor gauges ranked by physical similarity (standardised BasinATLAS catchment attributes); signatures transferred as an inverse-distance-weighted average over the k nearest donors (geometric mean for magnitudes) and/or by ridge regression on the attributes over all donors; the band is one weighted standard deviation of the donors (or the regression residual). _Bloeschl, G. et al. (eds.) (2013). Runoff Prediction in Ungauged Basins. Cambridge University Press; Oudin, L. et al. (2008). Water Resour. Res. 44, W03413; Addor, N. et al. (2018). A ranking of hydrological signatures based on their predictability in space. Water Resour. Res. 54, 8792-8812._
